name: Deviation Edge Force Parameter (COMPAS CEM)
description: Set the force of a deviation edge as an optimization parameter.

inputParameters.name: edge_key
inputParameters.description: The key of a COMPAS CEM deviation edge.

inputParameters.name: bound_low
inputParameters.description: The smallest signed force the deviation edge may take. The start value must lie between the bounds. Defaults to '-inf'.

inputParameters.name: bound_up
inputParameters.description: The largest signed force the deviation edge may take. The start value must lie between the bounds. Defaults to '+inf'.

outputParameters.name: parameter
outputParameters.description: A COMPAS CEM deviation edge force parameter.
